title: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
tldr_zh: 插值加潜变量与可调扩散系数，同一路径可 ODE/SDE 采样；SDE 的 KL 受回归损失控制而 ODE 不行；对插值优化得 SB
tldr_en: Interpolants with latent noise and tunable diffusion give ODE/SDE samplers sharing one density path; SDE likelihood is controlled by regression loss, ODE is not; max-min over interpolants yields the Schrodinger bridge.
key_numbers: KL(rho_1 || hat rho(1)) <= (1/2eps)(L_b excess) + (eps/2)(L_s excess) for SDE samplers (Theorem 23, Eq. 2.45)
Optimal diffusion coefficient eps* = sqrt(L_b excess / L_s excess) (Remark 24, Eq. 2.49)
For ODE samplers KL equals integral of (grad log hat rho - grad log rho).(hat b - b) rho: drift error alone is insufficient (Lemma 21, Eq. 2.39)
Only gamma(t)=sqrt(a t(1-t)) makes endpoint velocity carry the scores of rho_0, rho_1 (Remark 42, Table 2)
